title: Venetian Bronze Carolina Recessed Toilet Paper Holder - 6.125-Inch Square In-Wall Mount, Brass, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Venetian Bronze, create a clean, built-in look while saving space around the toilet with a recessed toilet paper holder, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. to match any decor.

  • Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Pairs elegantly with matching Carolina hardware for refined warmth
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Count on long-lasting performance with a corrosion-free, rust-free designer finish
  • Install with confidence—mounting hardware is included

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection.

Specs
- Product type: Recessed toilet paper holder
- Mounting: Recessed (in-wall)
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 in x 6.125 in x 4 in
- Projection: 4 in
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Included: Recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Style: Traditional
